title: Storage Rental End-of-Rental Condition, Lease Move-Out, Transfers, Unit Changes and Stored Items
content:
A Storage Rental unit must be left empty and broom-clean on its end date, the rental ends with the lease's move-out date, and, where the product carries over, it follows the lease on an in-community transfer. The cleanout fee, holding period, change fee, transfer term and item restrictions are those of the product rented.

## At the end date

- On the end date the unit must be empty and broom-clean; otherwise the product's cleanout fee is billed.
- Contents left behind are held for the product's holding period, in calendar days after the end date, before removal.

| Unit on the end date | Cleanout fee |
|---|---|
| Empty and broom-clean | Not billed |
| Not empty, or not broom-clean | Billed |

## When possession of the apartment home ends

Every Storage Rental ends on the lease's move-out date, without notice and without an early termination fee. This applies whether the rental is active, overlocked or under notice at that time; the rental's end date is the lease's move-out date and the rental is vacated.

## In-community transfer

A Storage Rental carries over on an in-community transfer of the lease when the product carries over on a transfer. Every Storage Rental product currently does.

## Changing unit or product

A move to another storage unit or another Storage Rental product bills the unit change fee and restarts neither the rate hold nor the minimum rental. After the change, the rental shows the new unit, the product after the change and the rent after the change.

*Hypothetical case.* A Standard Storage Unit (5x5) rental that started on 10 March moves to a Large Storage Unit (5x10) on 1 May. The $25.00 unit change fee is billed. The rate hold and the minimum rental are still measured from the start date of 10 March; neither starts again on 1 May.

## What may be stored

Stored items must respect the product's list of items that may never be stored, its term on hazardous materials (fuel, propane and the like) and its term on motorized vehicles (motorcycles, scooters and the like).

## Basis questions

**Does a resident who moves out of the apartment home need to give storage notice?** No. The rental ends on the lease's move-out date without notice.

**Is an early termination fee billed when the rental ends because the lease's move-out date arrived?** No. A rental ending on the lease's move-out date carries no early termination fee.

**What does a change of unit or product do to the rental?** The change bills the fee and updates the unit, the product and the rent; the rate hold and the minimum rental keep running from the original start.
